extract_cpc_features_from_audio: use CpcFeatureReader to extract CPC features from an audio WAV file given a checkpoint path
load_cpc_model_from_checkpoint: use load_cpc_model to load a CPC model from a checkpoint file with an optional layer parameter
read_audio_with_channel_selection: use CpcFeatureReader.read_audio to read a WAV file and optionally select a specific stereo channel
build_cpc_encoder_network: build a CPCEncoder convolutional network with configurable hidden dimension for audio feature encoding
extract_features_with_normalization: use CPCModel.extract_features to extract and optionally normalize CPC features from a source tensor
